groups.name: SCALES
groups.why: Five-note, twelve-note, all-whole-steps, and the blues scale. DIMINISHED and AUGMENTED name real scales too, but they are needed in the chord group.

groups.name: MINOR-3RD MODES
groups.why: Each has a flat 3rd above its tonic. Ionian, Lydian and Mixolydian are the major-3rd modes.

groups.name: CHORD QUALITIES
groups.why: Augmented = major 3rd + sharp 5. Diminished = flat 3 + flat 5. Sus = the 3rd swapped for a 2nd or 4th. Dominant 7 = major triad + flat 7. MAJOR is a quality too, but it enlisted.

groups.name: ARMY WORDS TOO
groups.why: A major is a rank and a key. A march is a step and a genre. Taps and Reveille are the bugle calls for lights-out and wake-up.

groups.name: TEMPOS
groups.why: Allegro = fast and lively, andante = walking pace, adagio = slow, presto = very fast.

groups.name: DYNAMICS
groups.why: Piano = soft, crescendo = get louder, diminuendo = get softer, sforzando = a sudden strong accent. FORTE is a dynamic too, but it drove off.

groups.name: BOWED STRINGS
groups.why: All played with a bow (a fiddle is a violin with a different attitude). The piano has strings too, but felt hammers strike them.

groups.name: CAR NAMES
groups.why: Hyundai Sonata, Honda Prelude, Kia Cadenza, Kia Forte. Carmakers love a music word. The Italian Job is a car-chase movie, so this was always the getaway group.

groups.name: NOTE VALUES
groups.why: Whole, half, quarter, eighth: each lasts half as long as the one before. EIGHTH hides the number EIGHT, but it is too honest to count as hidden.

groups.name: VOICE TYPES
groups.why: Choir voices from high to low. TENOR and BARITONE are voices too, but they are smuggling numbers.

groups.name: TWOS
groups.why: Dyad = two-note chord, duplet = two notes in the time of three, duet = a piece for two, duple meter = two beats a bar. HALF is one of two halves, but it is a note value.

groups.name: HIDDEN NUMBERS
groups.why: TENor, bariTONE hides ONE (bariT-ONE), TENuto, xylophONE. Count the letters, not the beats.

groups.name: FRETTED INSTRUMENTS
groups.why: Metal frets across the neck mark each half step. A violin has a neck but no frets.

groups.name: KEYBOARD INSTRUMENTS
groups.why: All played from a keyboard. The celesta is the bell-like sound in Tchaikovsky's Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy.

groups.name: PIANO PARTS
groups.why: Press the key, the damper lifts, the hammer hits the string, and the soundboard makes it loud.

groups.name: ALSO BASEBALL WORDS
groups.why: Pitch: a note's highness or a throw. Run: a fast scale or a score. Slide: a guitar slide or into second. Hit: a chart smash or a single to left.

groups.name: SOLFEGE
groups.why: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti. Four of the seven syllables, spelled the classroom way.

groups.name: STAFF LINES AND SPACES
groups.why: Treble spaces F-A-C-E, treble lines E-G-B-D-F, bass spaces A-C-E-G, bass lines G-B-D-F-A, bottom to top.

groups.name: SHARPS AND FLATS ON WHITE KEYS
groups.why: E♯ = F, B♯ = C, F♭ = E, C♭ = B. You meet E♯ in F♯ major and C♭ in G♭ major.

groups.name: DO-RE-MI PUNS
groups.why: From the Sound of Music song: doe a deer, ray a drop of golden sun, me a name I call myself, far a long way to run. They sound like do, re, mi, fa but are spelled as words.

groups.name: MAJOR 7TH CHORDS
groups.why: Major triad + major 7th, a half step under the octave. In the room: 'the 7th butts the root.' Cmaj7 = C E G B.

groups.name: DOMINANT 7TH CHORDS
groups.why: Major triad + flat 7: the V7 of a key (G7 in C, D7 in G, C7 in F, A7 in D). Add a flat 9 and you have the classic dominant color.

groups.name: HALF-DIMINISHED: viiø7 IN MAJOR
groups.why: Diminished triad + minor 7th: viiø7 in C, G, F and D major. Not °7: a fully diminished 7th needs a diminished 7th on top.

groups.name: ONE °7 CHORD, FOUR NAMES
groups.why: A °7 is stacked minor 3rds, so B-D-F-A♭ repeats every three half steps. Whichever note you call the root, it is the same four notes. B°7 looked like Bø7's twin. It is one note darker.

groups.name: VIOLIN BOW PARTS
groups.why: The frog is the end you hold, the tip is the far end, the stick is the wooden shaft and the hair is horsehair, rosined.

groups.name: ORNAMENTS
groups.why: Trill = rapid alternation with the note above. Mordent = a quick flick to a neighbor and back. Turn = above, note, below, note. Appoggiatura = a leaning note that steals time.

groups.name: BRITISH NOTE NAMES
groups.why: UK names: semibreve = whole note, minim = half, crotchet = quarter, quaver = eighth.

groups.name: ALSO GOLF WORDS
groups.why: Swing is a jazz style, a hook is the catchy bit, pitch is how high a note is, and a round is Row, Row, Row Your Boat. TURN is golf too (the turn after nine holes), but it is an ornament.

groups.name: PARENT KEY: C MAJOR
groups.why: All white keys. D Dorian and G Mixolydian share C, along with A Aeolian and F Lydian. Same notes, different home base.

groups.name: PARENT KEY: G MAJOR
groups.why: Every one uses F♯. C Lydian's raised 4th is that F♯, which puts its parent at G.

groups.name: PARENT KEY: F MAJOR
groups.why: Every one uses B♭. C Mixolydian's parent is F: same notes as F major, starting on C.

groups.name: MODE HOME CHORDS, PARENT NUMERALS
groups.why: Count from the parent major key, never from the mode's root: Dorian's home chord is ii, Phrygian's is iii, Lydian's is IV, Mixolydian's is V.

groups.name: DRUM KIT
groups.why: Snare drum, hi-hat, ride cymbal and crash cymbal: standard drum kit gear.

groups.name: DRUMMERS PLAY WITH
groups.why: Sticks, wire brushes, soft mallets and bundled rods: four ways to hit a drum.

groups.name: INSIDE A PIANO
groups.why: Felt hammers strike the strings, dampers stop them, and the soundboard makes them loud enough to hear.

groups.name: ALSO IN A TOOLBOX
groups.why: A guitar pick, a musical saw played with a bow, recording tape, and sandpaper blocks from the rhythm band. HAMMER and MALLETS belong in a toolbox too, but they have piano and drum jobs.

groups.name: PROPERTIES OF SOUND
groups.why: How high, what color, how long, how loud: the four things your ear measures in every note.

groups.name: RHYTHM WORDS
groups.why: Beat = the steady unit, tempo = its speed, meter = how beats group, pulse = the heartbeat under it all. BEAT also sounds like beet, but the homophone group is all instruments.

groups.name: PLUCKED STRINGS
groups.why: All plucked. LYRE and LUTE are plucked strings too, but they had another job.

groups.name: INSTRUMENTS WITH A SOUNDALIKE
groups.why: Cymbal/symbol, lyre/liar, bell/belle, lute/loot.

groups.name: PERFECT INTERVALS
groups.why: Unison, 4th, 5th and octave are the perfect intervals. The tritone sits between the 4th and 5th and is not perfect.

groups.name: MAJOR-OR-MINOR INTERVALS
groups.why: 2nds, 3rds, 6ths and 7ths come in major and minor. SECOND is also a unit of time, but here it is a step.

groups.name: KINDS OF MINOR
groups.why: Harmonic, melodic and natural minor scales, and the relative minor that shares a major key's notes. NATURAL is also an accidental.

groups.name: ___TONE
groups.why: Tritone = three whole steps, baritone = the voice between tenor and bass, semitone = a half step, overtone = a higher partial ringing above the note.

groups.name: MAJOR TRIADS
groups.why: Major 3rd on the bottom, minor 3rd on top. D major needs F♯.

groups.name: MINOR TRIADS
groups.why: Minor 3rd on the bottom, major 3rd on top. E-G-B is minor. Flat that B and it turns diminished.

groups.name: DIMINISHED TRIADS
groups.why: Two stacked minor 3rds. B-D-F is the vii° chord in C major.

groups.name: AUGMENTED TRIADS
groups.why: Two stacked major 3rds. E augmented is spelled E-G♯-B♯, not C: a 5th above E has to be a B of some kind.

groups.name: LATIN DANCES
groups.why: Tango (Argentina), samba (Brazil), rumba and mambo (Cuba). Count them in 2 or 4, not 3. SALSA is a Latin dance too, but it went to the snack table.

groups.name: DANCES IN 3/4
groups.why: All triple meter. Chopin wrote waltzes, mazurkas and polonaises, which is the trap.

groups.name: CHOPIN GENRES, NO DANCES
groups.why: Nocturne = night piece, etude = study, prelude = short opener, ballade = a story told in sound.

groups.name: ALSO ON THE MENU
groups.why: Salsa the genre, a jam session, a drum roll, and the shake, the old English name for a trill. Also a dip, a spread, bread and a milkshake.

groups.name: ARTICULATIONS
groups.why: Staccato = short and detached, legato = smooth and connected, tenuto = hold it full value, marcato = marked and strong.

groups.name: ROAD-MAP MARKINGS
groups.why: Da capo = back to the top, dal segno = back to the sign, segno = the sign itself, coda = the tail-end section. FINE is a road-map word too, but it had an English meaning to use.

groups.name: SLOW TEMPOS
groups.why: Largo = broad, lento = slow, adagio = at ease, larghetto = a little less slow than largo. GRAVE is slower still, but it also digs.

groups.name: ALSO ENGLISH, NEW MEANING
groups.why: Fine = the end (fee-nay), not OK. Grave = very slow and solemn, not a burial. Forte = loud, not your strong suit. Presto = very fast, not a magic word.

groups.name: BAROQUE COMPOSERS
groups.why: Roughly 1600 to 1750: Bach, Handel, Vivaldi (The Four Seasons) and Purcell, England's Baroque star.

groups.name: CLASSICAL-ERA COMPOSERS
groups.why: Roughly 1750 to 1820. Haydn, Mozart, Salieri (Mozart's real-life colleague) and Gluck, who reformed opera.

groups.name: ROMANTIC COMPOSERS
groups.why: The 1800s: big feelings, big pianos. Chopin, Liszt, Brahms and Robert Schumann.

groups.name: COMPOSERS WHO ARE ALSO WORDS
groups.why: John Cage, Philip Glass, Maurice Ravel and Alban Berg: a cage, a glass, to ravel (tangle), an iceberg's berg. All four lived in the 1900s. Ravel was born in 1875, so he looks Romantic.

groups.name: JAZZ TRUMPETERS
groups.why: Louis Armstrong, Miles Davis, Dizzy Gillespie and Wynton Marsalis. Wynton's brother Branford plays sax, which is the trap.

groups.name: JAZZ SAXOPHONISTS
groups.why: Charlie Parker, John Coltrane, Sonny Rollins and Stan Getz.

groups.name: INSTRUMENTS NAMED FOR PEOPLE
groups.why: Saxophone (Adolphe Sax), sousaphone (made for John Philip Sousa's band), Moog synthesizer (Robert Moog), theremin (Leon Theremin).

groups.name: JAZZ NOBILITY
groups.why: Duke Ellington, Count Basie, Lady Day (Billie Holiday) and King Oliver, Louis Armstrong's mentor.

groups.name: BEATLES FIRST NAMES
groups.why: Lennon, McCartney, Harrison and Starr.

groups.name: BEATLES ALBUMS
groups.why: Rubber Soul (1965), Revolver (1966), Abbey Road (1969), Let It Be (1970). Let It Be is also a song, which is the trap.

groups.name: BEATLES SONGS, NO ALBUM TITLE
groups.why: Famous Beatles songs, none of them an album title. Penny Lane is also a real street in Liverpool.

groups.name: ROLLING STONES SONGS
groups.why: (I Can't Get No) Satisfaction (1965), Paint It Black (1966), Wild Horses (1971), Angie (1973). Different band, same British Invasion.

groups.name: MOTOWN GROUPS
groups.why: All Motown groups. The Commodores also launched Lionel Richie.

groups.name: MOTOWN SOLO STARS
groups.why: All recorded for Motown labels. Diana Ross went solo after the Supremes.

groups.name: MEMPHIS SOUL ON STAX
groups.why: Stax Records in Memphis was Motown's grittier rival: Otis Redding, Sam & Dave, Booker T. & the M.G.'s, Isaac Hayes.

groups.name: DETROIT STARS, NEVER ON MOTOWN
groups.why: Aretha Franklin grew up in Detroit but recorded for Columbia and then Atlantic. Eminem, Jack White and Alice Cooper are Detroit too, nowhere near Motown.

groups.name: COUNTRY STARS BY FIRST NAME
groups.why: Reba McEntire, Dolly Parton, Shania Twain, Garth Brooks.

groups.name: JAM BANDS
groups.why: Long songs, longer solos, no two shows alike: the Grateful Dead, Phish, the Allman Brothers Band and Widespread Panic.

groups.name: GRATEFUL DEAD SONGS
groups.why: Bertha (1971), Ripple and Truckin' (1970) and Althea (1980). Bertha and Althea look like country first names.

groups.name: PHISH SONGS
groups.why: Wilson is from the Gamehendge saga. Cavern and Stash are on A Picture of Nectar. Ghost is from The Story of the Ghost.

groups.name: TOTO SONGS
groups.why: All Toto. Their drummer, Jeff Porcaro, also played on Steely Dan records.

groups.name: FLEETWOOD MAC ALBUMS
groups.why: Rumours (1977), Tusk (1979), Mirage (1982), Tango in the Night (1987).

groups.name: EAGLES ALBUMS
groups.why: Desperado (1973), On the Border (1974), Hotel California (1976), The Long Run (1979).

groups.name: STEELY DAN ALBUMS
groups.why: Pretzel Logic (1974), Katy Lied (1975), Aja (1977), Gaucho (1980). Keyboard players study the chords on Aja like scripture.

groups.name: PIANO MAKERS
groups.why: Four piano brands: Steinway (New York and Hamburg), Yamaha and Kawai (Japan), Baldwin (Ohio-born).

groups.name: JAZZ PIANO GIANTS
groups.why: Thelonious Monk, Bill Evans, Art Tatum, Herbie Hancock. MONK sounds like church, but he is not a chess piece.

groups.name: KEYBOARDISTS: DOORS, YES, DEEP PURPLE, PHISH
groups.why: Ray Manzarek, Rick Wakeman, Jon Lord, Page McConnell. LORD sounds royal, but he played the Hammond.

groups.name: CHESS PIECES
groups.why: Carole King, Queen, Gladys Knight and Stephen Bishop (On and On, 1977). Carole King plays piano, which is the trap.

groups.name: ROLLING STONES
groups.why: Mick Jagger, Keith Richards, Charlie Watts and Ronnie Wood. Only four Stones on the board, so Watts stays home.

groups.name: AMERICAN COMPOSERS
groups.why: Aaron Copland (no E), George Gershwin, Leonard Bernstein, Charles Ives.

groups.name: ROCK DRUMMERS
groups.why: John Bonham (Led Zeppelin), Keith Moon (The Who), Neil Peart (Rush), Stewart Copeland (The Police, with an E, unlike Aaron Copland). Charlie WATTS is a rock drummer too, but the Stones need him.

groups.name: DRUM ___
groups.why: Drum solo, drum roll, drumbeat, drumline.

groups.name: TAYLOR SWIFT SONGS
groups.why: Love Story (2008), Shake It Off and Blank Space (2014), Anti-Hero (2022).

groups.name: ED SHEERAN SONGS
groups.why: Thinking Out Loud and Photograph (2014), Shape of You and Perfect (2017). He and Taylor Swift have duetted, which is the trap.

groups.name: SONGS TITLED WITH A WOMAN'S NAME
groups.why: The Police, Dolly Parton, Derek and the Dominos, Elvis Costello. Come On Eileen has a name in it, but it is not just the name.

groups.name: US ONE-HIT WONDERS
groups.why: Los del Rio, Toni Basil, Soft Cell and Dexys Midnight Runners: each act's one giant US hit. Mickey is about a guy, which kept it off the name list.

groups.name: BANDS WITH NUMBERS
groups.why: Numbers in the name. Maroon 5 is still technically five-ish.

groups.name: BANDS NAMED FOR PLACES
groups.why: Two cities and two states, all bands: Chicago (horns), Boston (More Than a Feeling), Kansas (Carry On Wayward Son), Alabama (country).

groups.name: ANIMAL BANDS, SPELLED RIGHT
groups.why: The Eagles, The Turtles, Buddy Holly's Crickets and The Animals. Proper spelling.

groups.name: ANIMAL BANDS, SPELLED WRONG
groups.why: Beetles with a beat, Monkeys with double E, Birds with a Y, Gorillas with a Z.

groups.name: JOHN WILLIAMS SCORES
groups.why: Two notes of shark, a galaxy far away, a flying hero and a boy wizard: all John Williams.

groups.name: HENRY MANCINI TUNES
groups.why: Peter Gunn (1958), Moon River (1961), The Pink Panther and Charade (1963).

groups.name: FILM COMPOSERS
groups.why: John Williams, Hans Zimmer (The Lion King), Danny Elfman (The Simpsons theme), Ennio Morricone (The Good, the Bad and the Ugly). MANCINI scored films too, but he made Grammy history.

groups.name: GRAMMY FIRSTS
groups.why: Mancini won the first Album of the Year (The Music from Peter Gunn, 1959). Modugno's Volare won the first Record of the Year. Bobby Darin was the first Best New Artist (1960). DJ Jazzy Jeff & the Fresh Prince won the first rap Grammy (1989).

groups.name: MUSIC FESTIVALS
groups.why: California, Chicago, Tennessee and England. WOODSTOCK looks like one, but here it is a song.

groups.name: JONI MITCHELL SONGS
groups.why: She wrote Woodstock in a New York hotel room after skipping the festival; Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young made it a 1970 hit.

groups.name: PLAYED WOODSTOCK, 1969
groups.why: Jimi Hendrix closed the festival with The Star-Spangled Banner. Santana, Janis Joplin and Joan Baez were all on the bill.

groups.name: SKIPPED WOODSTOCK, 1969
groups.why: Bob Dylan lived near the town of Woodstock, NY, and still skipped it. The Doors and Led Zeppelin turned it down. Joni Mitchell stayed in New York for The Dick Cavett Show.

groups.name: VERDI OPERAS
groups.why: Giuseppe Verdi's operas. Otello and Falstaff come from Shakespeare, and so does TEMPEST, which is the trap.

groups.name: SYMPHONY NICKNAMES
groups.why: Haydn 94 (Surprise), Mozart 41 (Jupiter), Beethoven 3 (Eroica), Dvorak 9 (From the New World).

groups.name: BEETHOVEN PIANO SONATA NICKNAMES
groups.why: Op. 27 No. 2 (Moonlight), Op. 57 (Appassionata), Op. 53 (Waldstein), Op. 31 No. 2 (Tempest).

groups.name: CHOPIN NICKNAMES
groups.why: Minute Waltz (Op. 64 No. 1), Raindrop Prelude (Op. 28 No. 15), Revolutionary Etude (Op. 10 No. 12), Butterfly Etude (Op. 25 No. 9). Madama Butterfly is an opera, but by Puccini.

groups.name: SONGS WITH A DAY
groups.why: The Bangles, the Rolling Stones, Katy Perry and Maroon 5.

groups.name: OPERA TENORS
groups.why: Placido Domingo, Luciano Pavarotti and Jose Carreras (the Three Tenors) plus Enrico Caruso. Domingo is Spanish for Sunday, which is the trap.

groups.name: SONGS WITH A MONTH
groups.why: Earth, Wind & Fire, Guns N' Roses, The Four Seasons (Oh, What a Night) and U2.

groups.name: BANDS WITH A TIME OF DAY OR WEEK
groups.why: The Weeknd, Green Day, Happy Mondays (Manchester) and Midnight Oil (Australia). Bands, not songs.

groups.name: DISNEY SONGS
groups.why: Frozen, The Little Mermaid, Moana, Beauty and the Beast.

groups.name: BEATLES SONGS
groups.why: All Beatles. Yellow Submarine lives under the sea, and Help! and Yellow Submarine were movies too.

groups.name: BROADWAY SHOWS THAT BECAME MOVIES
groups.why: Stage first, screen second. Mamma Mia! is built on ABBA songs.

groups.name: TAYLOR SWIFT ALBUMS
groups.why: Red (2012), Lover (2019), folklore (2020), Midnights (2022).

groups.name: BTS SONGS
groups.why: Dynamite and Butter (2020, 2021) were their English-language smashes. Idol and Fake Love came in 2018.

groups.name: MAROON 5 SONGS
groups.why: Payphone (2012), Animals and Sugar (2014), Memories (2019).

groups.name: OLIVIA RODRIGO SONGS
groups.why: drivers license, deja vu and good 4 u (2021), vampire (2023).

groups.name: BILLIE EILISH SONGS
groups.why: ocean eyes (2016), lovely with Khalid (2018), bad guy (2019), Happier Than Ever (2021).

groups.name: MUSIC VIDEO GAMES
groups.why: Plastic guitar, full band, follow the dancer, and slice the beats in VR.

groups.name: MUSIC FORMATS
groups.why: Records, tapes, compact discs and the chunky 8-track cartridge.

groups.name: STREAMING SERVICES
groups.why: All music streaming apps. Pandora is also a myth figure, but here it plays your station.

groups.name: INSTRUMENTS HIDING INSTRUMENTS
groups.why: HARPsichord, BASSoon, violonCELLO, flugelHORN. Bassoon and violoncello are each other's low end too.

groups.name: ONE-NAME SINGERS
groups.why: First names or stage names, no last names needed.

groups.name: STAGE SURNAMES FROM OUTER SPACE
groups.why: Bruno Mars, Freddie Mercury, Ringo Starr (two Rs) and Keith Moon.

groups.name: REAL FIRST NAMES: STING, BONO, ELTON, GAGA
groups.why: Gordon Sumner, Paul Hewson, Reginald Dwight, Stefani Germanotta. Not Gwen.

groups.name: HIDDEN ONE-NAME SINGER
groups.why: harMONICA, accorDION, sEVEnth, PINK Floyd: Monica, Dion, Eve and P!nk.

groups.name: SABRINA CARPENTER SONGS
groups.why: Nonsense and Feather (2022), Espresso and Taste (2024). Espresso is coffee, but here it is a hit.

groups.name: JUG BAND INSTRUMENTS
groups.why: Kitchen and laundry gear turned band. CHOPSTICKS looks like cutlery, but it is a song.

groups.name: SONGS NAMED FOR FRUIT
groups.why: Justin Bieber, Harry Styles, Fats Domino and The Runaways.

groups.name: FIRST SONGS PIANO STUDENTS LEARN
groups.why: Three notes, then Beethoven's Ninth, then the holidays, then the duet everyone plays. They sound like snacks; they are songs.

groups.name: SONGS ABOUT CANDY
groups.why: The Chordettes (1958), the Archies (1969), the Strangeloves (1965) and Joey Dee and the Starliters (1961).

groups.name: HITS FROM SUPERHERO MOVIES
groups.why: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, Black Panther, Batman Forever and Tim Burton's Batman (Prince, 1989).

groups.name: MUSIC NICKNAMES
groups.why: Bruce Springsteen, Elvis Presley, Louis Armstrong, Eric Clapton. Billy Joel is the Piano Man, but that tile went to the ___ MAN group.

groups.name: ___ MAN SONGS
groups.why: Piano Man (Billy Joel), Rocket Man (Elton John), Soul Man (Sam & Dave), The Candy Man (Sammy Davis Jr., a 1972 No. 1).

groups.name: BROADWAY MUSICALS
groups.why: Hamilton, Wicked, Cats, Annie.

groups.name: SONGS FROM ANNIE
groups.why: Tomorrow, Maybe, It's the Hard-Knock Life and Easy Street.

groups.name: SONGS FROM HAMILTON
groups.why: Four numbers from Lin-Manuel Miranda's 2015 show.

groups.name: NATIONAL MUSIC AWARDS
groups.why: Grammy (USA), Brit (UK), Juno (Canada), ARIA (Australia). ARIA looks like an opera song, but here it is a trophy.

groups.name: VIVALDI'S FOUR SEASONS
groups.why: Vivaldi's four violin concertos from 1725. Donna Summer is a different season.

groups.name: MUSIC BIOPICS
groups.why: Elton John (2019), Ray Charles (2004), Elvis Presley (2022), Johnny Cash (2005).

groups.name: ACTS WITH A ROYAL TITLE
groups.why: Bands and artists named like royalty.

groups.name: KING OF POP, QUEEN OF SOUL, QUEEN OF DISCO, KING OF SWING
groups.why: Royal nicknames earned on the charts, not in a castle.

groups.name: SONGS ABOUT DOGS
groups.why: Elvis (and Big Mama Thornton first), the B-I-N-G-O camp song, Paul McCartney's sheepdog, and Elvis again with Old Shep.

groups.name: ACTS WITH A DOG IN THE NAME
groups.why: A rapper, a 1970s hit machine (Joy to the World), another rapper, and Chris Cornell's 1991 Seattle supergroup.

groups.name: SPEAKER PARTS
groups.why: Woofer = low sounds, tweeter = high sounds, subwoofer = the rumble, crossover = the circuit that sends each its share. WOOFER barks, but it is hardware.

groups.name: STARTS WITH A DOG COMMAND
groups.why: Stay (Rihanna, 2012), Speak Now (Taylor Swift album, 2010), Come Together (Beatles), Shake It Off (Taylor Swift). Good dog.

groups.name: SONGS STARTING WITH BABY
groups.why: Pinkfong, Raffi, the Supremes and Simon & Garfunkel. The lone BABY tile is on an album cover.

groups.name: PERCUSSION
groups.why: Shake it, click it, strike it. TRIANGLE is a shape too, and the PRISM looked like its cousin.

groups.name: HIT COVERS: SOMEONE ELSE DID IT FIRST
groups.why: Otis Redding (1965) before Aretha (1967), Leonard Cohen before Jeff Buckley, the Top Notes (1961) before the Isley Brothers and the Beatles, Bob Dylan before the Byrds' No. 1.

groups.name: ON FAMOUS ALBUM COVERS
groups.why: Pink Floyd's The Dark Side of the Moon (prism), The Velvet Underground & Nico (banana), Nirvana's Nevermind (baby), the Beatles' Abbey Road (crosswalk).

groups.name: SONGS WITH NUMBERS (NOT ALBUMS)
groups.why: Taylor Swift, Ariana Grande, Dolly Parton and Nena. 22 looked like an Adele age. It is a Taylor single.

groups.name: PIANO KEYS, GUITAR STRINGS, STAFF LINES, VIOLIN STRINGS
groups.why: 88 keys on a standard piano, 6 strings on a guitar, 5 lines on a staff, 4 strings on a violin.

groups.name: NUMBER ALBUMS: SWIFT, BRUNO MARS, PRINCE, VAN HALEN
groups.why: 1989 (Taylor Swift, 2014), 24K Magic (Bruno Mars, 2016), 1999 (Prince, 1982), 1984 (Van Halen, 1984).

groups.name: GUITAR BRANDS
groups.why: Four American guitar makers.

groups.name: GUITAR MODELS
groups.why: Fender's Strat and Tele, Gibson's SG and Flying V. FRANKENSTRAT started as a Strat-style body, but it has a name of its own.

groups.name: SONGS ERIC CLAPTON SANG
groups.why: Layla (with Derek and the Dominos), Wonderful Tonight (1977), Tears in Heaven (1992), Change the World (1996).

groups.name: FAMOUS GUITARS WITH NAMES
groups.why: B.B. King's Lucille, Eric Clapton's Blackie, Willie Nelson's Trigger, Eddie Van Halen's Frankenstrat.
